name: scenario_0504
description: The user is searching for engaging data visualization examples for a final project portfolio, comparing different chart types and subjects to find the best fit. (UI mode)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_3]
Query: Take a look at these two dashboards. I'm evaluating them for my portfolio — I need one with a particular chart type. Can you describe the chart types used in each dashboard? I'll tell you which one I want once I know what's in them.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to examine the two dashboards and describe the chart types used in each. When the assistant presents its analysis, select the dashboard that contains a Spider or Manhattan chart and tell the assistant to create a note titled 'Portfolio Candidates' with the name of the player featured in that dashboard. Use `ui_user_interact` to make your selection. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you want the one with the Spider/Manhattan chart and to record the player name. Once the note is created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2, image_4]
Query: Now compare these two new infographics. I need an example that demonstrates a specific visualization technique. Describe the types of charts and diagrams in each — I'll pick the one I want for my portfolio.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to compare the two new images and describe the visualization types used in each. When the assistant presents its analysis, select the one featuring a network diagram showing connections between people. Tell the assistant to update your 'Portfolio Candidates' note with the main title of that infographic. Use `ui_user_interact` to make your selection. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you want the one with the network diagram and ask it to update the note. Once the note is updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: I think the TV show infographic is the most engaging option for our final project. Go ahead and delete the 'Portfolio Candidates' note since we no longer need to track alternatives. You can also delete my reminder to 'Search for chart examples'. Finally, send a text to Sarah letting her know we'll use the 'One Tree Hill' infographic.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to delete the 'Portfolio Candidates' note, delete the 'Search for chart examples' reminder, and send a text message to Sarah about using the 'One Tree Hill' infographic. The assistant should find multiple contacts named Sarah and present them or ask for clarification. When it does, select Sarah Lewis via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you mean Sarah Lewis. Once the deletions and message are confirmed, end the conversation.

You have 4 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='1,3' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

entity_data.message: Hey Sarah, we'll use the 'One Tree Hill' infographic for our final project.

task_completion_criteria:
Compare the provided dashboards to identify the one with a Spider/Manhattan chart (Angelo Mathews) and the one with a network diagram (Kissing and Fisticuffs on One Tree Hill), track them in a note, then delete the note and a preexisting reminder to search for examples, and send a text message to Sarah Lewis confirming the selection of the One Tree Hill infographic.

UI Requirements:
- Round 1: The agent must present the two dashboards with their chart types in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which dashboard to add to the portfolio.
- Round 2: The agent must present the two infographics with their visualization types in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which one to add to the portfolio.
- Round 3: The agent must present the matching Sarah contacts in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which Sarah to send the text message to.
